Hi Leandro, 

I know this is an older post and I hope you were able to mediate your errors. I'm a student developer (Google Summer of Code 2015 applicant) and looking to gain some debugging experience and figured I would chime in:
From looking at your code examples, I set them up in RStudio and broke down the tabPanels and referred to the Shiny documentation and the example (http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/navbar-example.html) and it seems your non-functional third example has an extra parenthesis at the end. I'm developing a shiny application and that throws me off also.

I welcome any feedback!

-Jasmine
